Jeedom adopte une version spécifique sur: Jeedom offers a dedicated version for mobile and tablet devices. You can access it using the same URL in a mobile browser (Firefox, Chrome, Safari, etc.).
Jeedom est utilisable sur Mobile de deux: Jeedom can be used on mobile devices in two ways.
L'application mobile Jeedom (compatible: The Jeedom mobile app (compatible with iOS/Android) lets you control your Jeedom home automation system, whether via your local Wi-Fi network or your carrier’s 3G/4G network. The app automatically connects to your Jeedom using a QR code—no configuration is required. You’ll find all the features of your Jeedom system on your phone (scenarios, connected devices and home automation devices, plugins). You can also customize your app with shortcuts and more...
La WebApp a un rôle principalement consu: The WebApp serves primarily as a reference tool. You can, of course, interact with your devices just as you would on the desktop version, but you won’t be able to, for example, edit a scenario, modify a device, or access Jeedom’s configuration.
La page d'accueil de la WebApp peu-être: The WebApp home page can be configured on your Jeedom under Settings → Preferences.
Plugins : Certains plugins peuvent avoir: Plugins: Some plugins may have a dedicated view in the WebApp. They will be accessible here.
Scénario : Affichage des tuiles de vos s: Scenario: Displays your scenario tiles by group, with the option to enable/disable or stop/start them. Clicking on the scenario title will take you to its log.
